title: The last seat
summary: Compare two-character staging, attention, social timing and readable gesture without narration.
originNote: Original fictional task proposed for the requested cross-model animation comparison; this draft benchmark shape awaits owner acceptance.

setup.instructions: Verify fixtures/skill.tar.gz against fixtures/skill-lock.json, extract it and read skill/SKILL.md. Use the immutable source snapshot. Before Ready, pin and smoke the Node (22 or later), Python, browser, FFmpeg, fonts and skill-specific dependencies identically for every model. This draft is not cookable.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.md and the pinned skill. Create The last seat using its workflow, and deliver the specified movie, live player, source, contact sheet and evidence. Make routine creative decisions yourself and iterate from rendered evidence.

checks.description: Check delivery files, unchanged player, PNG signature, H.264/AAC, 1080 by 1920, 24fps, 576 frames, 24 seconds and evidence structure.

Can you follow who notices, offers and responds in each beat? Do the characters have distinct posture and timing? Does the final shared seat feel physically possible and earned? Inspect actual playback, audio, authorship and correspondence between evidence times and visible events.
